rawReport.retention: Generated raw output remains ignored and can be replaced. CI retains browser artifacts for 14 days.

limitations: Headless desktop builds on the recorded macOS environment; no physical mobile or OS IME certification.
Injected clipboard/composition/native-input cases do not establish operating-system clipboard or actual IME behavior.
Installed React example uses development StrictMode and an uncontrolled textarea; no controlled-value/SSR/general framework claim.
Selected software regressions; no linguistic accuracy or independent human review claim.
All eight source hashes identify the tested runtime/declarations; documentation is outside that scope.
